paras.text: 1. Yahya bin Yahya al-Laythi "the Wise Man of Andalus"
paras.pashto: ۱. یحیی بن یحیی لیثي «د اندلس عاقل»

paras.text: Yahya bin Laythi belonged to the Masmudah tribe. This was a Berber tribe. First of all he performed Hajj. In 795 CE he became a pupil of Hazrat Imam Malik. He received the teaching of the Muwatta'. In Egypt he learned sciences from Layth Ibn Sa'd and in Makkah al-Mu'azzamah from Sufyan Ibn 'Uyaynah. He was of a high degree of piety and righteousness. In the era of government of Abd al-Rahman he announced the decisions of criminal cases. He was very outspoken and fearless. Yahya wanted to obtain not the pleasure of the king but the pleasure of Allah Almighty. In Abd al-Rahman's court Yahya had a high place. Abd al-Rahman, while recruiting qadis, certainly consulted Yahya. According to Ibn Hazm, in the East Hanafi fiqh obtained the support of the king because of Imam Abu Hanifah and Qadi Abu Yusuf, and in the West Maliki fiqh because of Yahya. He died in 849 CE.

paras.text: … could not be obtained. He obtained mastery of the religious sciences of his time. He was extremely pious and righteous. He was also a preacher of a high degree. زاہراوی کے ابتدائی حالات معلوم نہیں ہو سکے۔ یہ مدینۃ الزاہرا کا باشندہ تھا۔ جسے عبدالرحمان ثالث نے بسایا تھا۔ اس کی شہرت اس کی مشہورِ زمانہ کتاب ”زہراوی“ کی وجہ سے ہوئی۔ یہ کتاب علم و حکمت کا شاہکار ہے۔ یہ علمِ طب اور جراحت کی نایاب کتاب ہے۔ کہا جاتا ہے۔ کہ زہراوی حکیم پالوس سے متاثر تھا۔ کتاب میں آلاتِ جراحی کی تصاویر بھی دی گئی ہیں۔
